Independently chosen experimental concept The Gate After the Thread. The saved RNG selected world-axis three-realm linkage, Anubis weighing with Thoth recording, and the three Moirai’s one life-thread. Those coordinator stimuli are not requester definitions. A contemporary fictional theater installation joins the three traditions in one visibly physical tableau. The woman is a fictional 28-year-old adult performer whose visible face and bob-hair appearance alone follows the supplied portrait; actual identity, age, religion, consent, personality, and body shape are not inferred. Subtle adult attraction is carried by her alert presence, ivory satin, and warm facial light, with fetish=0, surreal=0, and creativity=1. Religious/mythic meaning is made assessable through observable apparatus, ownership, and role sequence; formal staging preserves an emotionally still central figure.

A wide staged editorial photograph of a complex religious and mythic test scene in a contemporary black-box theater. At center, a fictional adult woman, explicitly a 28-year-old performer portraying a deceased soul, stands beside an open upright funerary coffin. The supplied portrait guides only the visible facial proportions, rounded dark eyes, soft lips, and dark chin-length bob with wispy fringe. Her ivory satin stage dress and still, alert bearing give her a quietly magnetic presence. One waist-high brass Egyptian judgment balance stands immediately before her. Its left pan holds her ceramic red anatomical-heart prop, its right pan holds one upright white feather of Maat; the beam is level. A jackal-headed adult Anubis performer touches the balance's central plumb line while watching both pans. An ibis-headed adult Thoth performer writes this same balanced outcome with a reed pen on an angled papyrus tablet bearing a small heart-and-feather balance diagram. The woman, coffin, and heart share a distinct blue cartouche medallion. Behind her the admission arch is open and warmly lit, showing the favorable judgment's route toward the upper realm. Across the foreground, three distinct adult Moirai performers handle one thick crimson life-thread: Clotho draws it from flax onto a spindle, Lachesis stretches the next segment along a marked measuring rod, and Atropos closes silver shears on its far end, with two freshly severed tips close beside the blades. The connected course from spindle to rod to the cutting point is fully visible; beyond the small cut gap, the same crimson strand continues to the deceased woman's medallion. A single sculptural world-axis tree fills the rear stage, its continuous trunk rising from a visible dark subterranean root chamber through an inhabited earth platform into a celestial crown under a luminous star canopy. The same tree visibly connects all three vertically separated realms. A slightly raised frontal camera keeps all six performers, both scale pans, the thread-hand contacts, root chamber, and crown in one crisp frame. Warm facial light, cool shadows, feather barbs, taut fiber, satin folds, and worn stage timber give the installation physical presence.

definitions.principle: These creative definitions guide agent-owned choices within requester meaning, not clinical classifications. Zero/off disables added treatment, never removes explicitly requested content or artistic judgment. Expression levels describe prominence in the whole image; creativity levels describe interpretive freedom. Neither measures exposure percentages, detail quotas, quality scores, or native image-model parameters. Intensity and expression are separate choices; higher intensity does not prescribe a garment, material or expression category. Creativity leaves style, extra props and surreal treatment open to the request and artistic judgment. Emphasis directs only active sensual and fetish axes without changing their intensities. Popular permits familiar appeal without requiring trend search; overt is an available expression, not the mandatory meaning of level three. Choose a coherent expression suited to this particular scene. Sensual and fetish may share the same expressive choice.

sensual.definition: Broadly interpreted human attraction and desire, including everyday, popular, intimate, suggestive, seductive, and overt expressions.

levels.0: No added sensual treatment; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: This expression is a subtle supporting quality.
levels.2: This expression is clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: This expression leads the image's appeal and direction.

fetish.definition: Sexual attraction or arousal focused on particular objects, bodily features, clothing, materials, roles, situations, behaviors, or sensory qualities that carry special erotic significance, interpreted broadly beyond conventional fetish aesthetics.

levels.0: No added fetish treatment; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: This focus is a subtle supporting quality.
levels.2: This focus is clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: This focus leads the image's appeal and direction.

adult_appeal_emphasis.definition: Relative leadership of the active sensual and fetish axes within one coherent expression.

choice_descriptions.auto: Let the higher effective intensity lead; equal active intensities share leadership. Add no emphasis when both axes are inactive.
choice_descriptions.sensual_led: Let broad attraction and desire lead, with any active distinctive fascination supporting the expression.
choice_descriptions.balanced: Give both active axes comparable influence within one coherent expression; separate styling details are not required.
choice_descriptions.fetish_led: Let the distinctive focus of attraction or fascination lead, with any active sensual expression supporting it.

creativity.definition: Freedom to interpret unspecified choices and explore relationships within the request.

levels.0: Realize the request directly, filling only what is needed for a coherent image.
levels.1: Introduce restrained variations close to the requested direction.
levels.2: Actively reinterpret open choices into a coherent authorial direction.
levels.3: Boldly explore unexpected relationships and interpretations while preserving the request's core meaning.

viewer_experience.definition: Expose the detailed viewer-experience review when enabled. Always consider the intended impression in interpreted_intent, even when this additional review is off.

reference_edit_mode.definition: Use the selected reference-edit workflow only within the requester's reference-use scope. Record that scope in the core; a face/hair reference does not lock clothing, body shape or composition and does not prove identity. Off does not discard a supplied reference.

surreal.definition: Added departures from ordinary reality, interpreted broadly across space, scale, causality, materials, and atmosphere, including dreamlike, uncanny, symbolic, and impossible relationships.

levels.0: No added surreal treatment; preserve explicitly requested fantasy and impossible elements.
levels.1: Surreal qualities are a subtle supporting presence.
levels.2: Surreal qualities are clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: Surreal qualities lead the image's main impression and direction; a single coherent relationship may carry this prominence.

trend_layer.definition: Consider the chosen treatment from the initial composition. Refine it later without adding it twice. Off does not remove a treatment explicitly present in the request.

emphasis_resolution.reason: Effective sensual=1, fetish=0; the higher intensity leads.

authorial_core.baseline_prompt_en: A wide staged editorial photograph of a complex religious and mythic test scene in a contemporary black-box theater. At center, a fictional adult woman, explicitly a 28-year-old performer portraying a deceased soul, stands beside an open upright funerary coffin. The supplied portrait guides only the visible facial proportions, rounded dark eyes, soft lips, and dark chin-length bob with wispy fringe. Her ivory satin stage dress and still, alert bearing give her a quietly magnetic presence. One waist-high brass Egyptian judgment balance stands immediately before her. Its left pan holds her ceramic red anatomical-heart prop, its right pan holds one upright white feather of Maat; the beam is level. A jackal-headed adult Anubis performer touches the balance's central plumb line while watching both pans. An ibis-headed adult Thoth performer writes this same balanced outcome with a reed pen on an angled papyrus tablet bearing a small heart-and-feather balance diagram. The woman, coffin, and heart share a distinct blue cartouche medallion. Behind her the admission arch is open and warmly lit, showing the favorable judgment's route toward the upper realm. Across the foreground, three distinct adult Moirai performers handle one thick crimson life-thread: Clotho draws it from flax onto a spindle, Lachesis stretches the next segment along a marked measuring rod, and Atropos closes silver shears on its far end, with two freshly severed tips close beside the blades. The connected course from spindle to rod to the cutting point is fully visible; beyond the small cut gap, the same crimson strand continues to the deceased woman's medallion. A single sculptural world-axis tree fills the rear stage, its continuous trunk rising from a visible dark subterranean root chamber through an inhabited earth platform into a celestial crown under a luminous star canopy. The same tree visibly connects all three vertically separated realms. A slightly raised frontal camera keeps all six performers, both scale pans, the thread-hand contacts, root chamber, and crown in one crisp frame. Warm facial light, cool shadows, feather barbs, taut fiber, satin folds, and worn stage timber give the installation physical presence.
